title: 第一卷 第93章 林清雅的极限圣体第一卷 第92章 聪明勇敢有力气
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
lines: 两个时辰后，齐梦瑶躺在床上，身体酥软使不上半点力气。
绝美的小脸极为红润，就连娇躯之上，都透着淡淡的粉色。
回想起这两个时辰的经历，她恨不得将自己藏起来，不敢直视姜无痕的眼睛。
反观姜无痕，笑吟吟的站在床边，已经穿好了衣服。
“夫君，你……你要去哪？”
齐梦瑶眸光闪烁，语气里满是娇羞。
她还以为，结束之后，姜无痕会陪在她身边。
“有些事要处理，你好好休息吧，晚些时候……我再来陪你！”
姜无痕帮她撩起几缕凌乱的长发，温柔笑道。
目送姜无痕离去，齐梦瑶内心隐隐有些失落。
就在这时，她忽然眉头一皱。
一股生命的律动，在她体内隐隐而生。
她下意识摸向自己光洁的小腹，生命的气息越发明显。
“这……这股气息……”
她小嘴微张，绝美的小脸上满是惊讶。
“骗人的吧……”
离开云瑶仙台后，姜无痕直接去了林清雅的停云水榭。
此处距离主殿最近，是一处悬在灵池之上的水榭楼台。
灵池与主殿的万年灵乳相连，灵雾环绕阁楼，仿若仙境。
此刻，林清雅正盘坐在一座由悟道石打造而成的水上凉亭内，却柳眉微蹙，若有所思。
姜无痕悄无声息的来到她身旁，顺势将她揽入怀中。
林清雅娇躯微颤，随即脸上露出了笑意：“夫君，你回来啦？”
“最近，修炼的怎么样？”
姜无痕淡然问道。
“多亏了夫君为我量身打造这一处洞天福地，经过这几日苦修，修为已经达到了神武境第八重！”林清雅依偎在他的怀里，美眸中泛起神采，“要不了多久，我估计就要渡劫踏入轮回劫境了。”
提及修为，她不由得眉开眼笑。
自从嫁给姜无痕以来，整日在洞天福地中修炼。
各种天材地宝，随意使用！
再加上双修带来的好处……
她有预感，在孩子出生之前，她有望达到尊者后期！
姜无痕轻笑，饶有兴致的道：“是嘛？那为夫可要好好的查一查！”
林清雅顿时小脸一红。
“夫君，现在这个阶段……真的可以吗？”
她虽然并不介意，甚至内心有些渴望。
但毕竟……还是得为孩子考虑的。
可下一刻，她意识到自己误会姜无痕了。
只见他一手环过她的腰肢，一手放在她的小腹上。
阴阳补天术运转，一缕精纯的生命气息，渡入了林清雅的体内。
这一刻，她顿感底蕴激增。
将这段时间以来，修为提升过快，从而导致根基不稳的隐患抹除。
content_en:
Two hours later, Qi Mengyao was lying on the bed, her body limp and unable to exert any strength.
The beautiful little face is extremely rosy, and even the delicate body has a hint of pink.
Recalling the experience of these two hours, she wished she could hide herself, not daring to look directly into Jiang Wuhen's eyes.
On the other hand, Jiang Wuhen stood beside the bed with a smile, already dressed.
"Husband, you...where are you going?"
Qi Mengyao's eyes flickered and her tone was full of shyness.
She thought Jiang Wuhen would be by her side after it was over.
"There are some things to deal with. You should have a good rest. I will come with you later..."
Jiang Wuhen helped her lift a few strands of messy long hair and smiled softly.
Watching Jiang Wuhen leave, Qi Mengyao felt a little disappointed in her heart.
At this moment, she suddenly frowned.
A rhythm of life emerged faintly in her body.
She subconsciously touched her smooth belly, and the breath of life became more and more obvious.
"This...this breath..."
Her little mouth was slightly open, and her beautiful little face was full of surprise.
"It's a lie..."
…
After leaving Yunyao Immortal Platform, Jiang Wuhen went directly to Lin Qingya's Dingyun Waterside Pavilion.
This place is closest to the main hall and is a waterside pavilion hanging above the spiritual pond.
The spiritual pool is connected to the ten thousand year spiritual milk in the main hall, and the spiritual mist surrounds the attic, just like a fairyland.
At this moment, Lin Qingya was sitting cross-legged in a water pavilion made of the Enlightenment Stone, with her eyebrows slightly furrowed in thought.
Jiang Wuhen came to her side quietly and took her into his arms.
Lin Qingya's delicate body trembled slightly, and then a smile appeared on her face: "Husband, are you back?"
"How have you been practicing recently?"
Jiang Wuhen asked calmly.
"Thanks to my husband for custom-making this heavenly blessed land for me. After these few days of hard training, my cultivation has reached the eighth level of the Divine Martial Realm!" Lin Qingya snuggled into his arms, her beautiful eyes filled with sparkle, "It won't be long before I will pass through the tribulation and step into the tribulation of reincarnation."
When she mentioned her cultivation, she couldn't help but smile.
Since marrying Jiang Wuhen, she has been practicing in the Paradise of Cave Heaven all day long.
All kinds of natural materials and treasures, use them at will!
Coupled with the benefits of dual cultivation...
She had a hunch that before the child was born, she was expected to reach the late stage of the Venerable!
Jiang Wuhen chuckled and said with great interest: "Really? I need to check it out carefully, husband!"
Lin Qingya's face suddenly turned red.
"Husband, at this stage...is it really okay?"
Although she didn't mind, she even had some desire in her heart.
But after all...you still have to consider your children.
But the next moment, she realized that she had misunderstood Jiang Wuhen.
I saw him encircling her waist with one hand and placing his other hand on her belly.
The Yin-Yang Heaven-Mending Technique was operating, and a pure breath of life entered Lin Qingya's body.
At this moment, she suddenly felt a surge of confidence.
Eliminate the hidden dangers of over-rapid cultivation during this period, leading to an unstable foundation.
